assessments.reasoning: The License Index’s SCOPE.md at commit cdff8aeed68bf1f9c62d8c86159c7dc08b2d75d7 includes relevant data. Its admission table at bytes [533,942) defines a license as a grant with an identifiable text and edition supported by a controlling source. ODC’s versioned database grant meets that criterion. The table supplies the classification rule only.

The three captures from https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/by/1-0/ cover bytes [0,16384), [16384,32768) and [32768,46288) of one English HTML witness. Each reports the claimed whole-document SHA-256 d19b417c9ae059c2ed8c5a97f1e87b59574e0fe478191cc8544d5b13f4737c3b. The title and heading identify Open Data Commons Attribution License (ODC-By) v1.0. The preamble and sections 2–4 identify the database rights, grant and attribution conditions. The publisher’s navigation identifies this route as the full legal text.

The Index decision at commit afb962e68831a16accb80c70159b1e2f1fbb4dbc, bytes [3527,3739), records permanent ID 486e363c7c4a4406829f10c603368b5b, Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0, edition `odc-by-1-0`, revision `sha256:d19b417c9ae059c2ed8c5a97f1e87b59574e0fe478191cc8544d5b13f4737c3b`, kind `license` and lifecycle `active`. The ID matches the claim subject after its `e-` prefix. The SPDX identifier in the adjacent column is cross-reference context.

challenge.method: Tested substitution of the neighboring ODbL v1.0 record and the linked ODC-By summary for the claimed HTML specimen. Tested a blanket grant over database contents against the publisher’s example of a database of images.
challenge.results: ODbL v1.0 has a different legal-text route, entity ID and revision despite sharing the publisher, version number and Index lifecycle. The ODC-By page distinguishes the summary and plain-text version from its full HTML legal text. Section 2.4 expressly leaves copyright in individual images to separate licensing. These checks support the scoped identity and exclude the broader reading.

limitations: The grant concerns a database offered under the terms. Sections 2.3–2.4 exclude programs used to make or operate it, patents and trademarks, and limit coverage of rights in individual contents. A public-sector origin alone does not establish that a dataset was offered under ODC-By.

`active` means the Index maintains this reference for current lookup. Publisher currency, SPDX deprecation, use for a particular work, redistribution of the text, installation eligibility and consumer-release authorization each require separate evidence.
reasoning: Open Data Commons publishes the full English legal text of ODC-By v1.0 at its versioned route. Its grant over a database meets the Index definition of a license. The Index decision of 2026-11-26 assigns `active` to the exact entity and publisher representation in revision 2.
